confirmation k0 vs mjj-2010-garap-b (kb-2020 as p2)
mjj-2020-kb-2020.note: Only difference: Snorlax Zap Cannon (2020) vs Curse (2022). Zap Cannon is aimed at sensible targets (a predicted Zapdos, paralysing Exeggutor; a super-effective shot at Lapras that missed). Used in 436 of 851 Snorlax games, which win 0.589 vs 0.398 when unused - no sign of misuse. Against the nine panel teams with Miltank (the author's stated reason for Zap Cannon) kb-2022 - kb-2020 = +0.026 [-0.040, +0.097]: no unique advantage.

mjj-2013-mario.note: The distinguishing gimmicks are Belly Drum Snorlax and dual-screen Electrode. Games where the bot used Belly Drum win 0.362 vs 0.640 when Snorlax played without it; in the toriyama log Electrode Thunderbolts into Exeggutor, sets Light Screen only at low HP and dies without exploding. The inferiority is plausibly the bot's execution of the gimmicks, so the verdict is withheld.

logs: confirmation k0 vs hc75-1st-show (venom as p2)
mjj-2013-venom.note: The distinguishing plan is Sandstorm Tyranitar (plus Reflect Blissey). In all three logs Tyranitar sets Sandstorm on entry regardless of matchup (into a Machamp switch, into an Earthquake-using Snorlax, before being slept). Whether the chip plan is piloted competently cannot be established; verdict withheld.
